newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes firm on low dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes firm on low dollar demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed slightly higher due to a lack of demand for dollars, delers said.
The rupee closed at 56.74 after opening at its previous closing level of 56.78.
"There was virtually no commercial demand, and no one is building positions this close to the year-end," said an American Express dealer.
Call money closed at 26 percent, after volatile trading which saw rates start at 16 and rise to 21 percent in early trading, dealers said.
